agreement_check.note: Sprint weekends are declared by FR-108's weekend format, read from the event schedule. The results endpoint is a second, independent source. Both were compared rather than one being trusted.

pagination.note: FR-110. 2023 is the case that matters: an unpaginated request returns 2 of its 6 sprints and reports no error.

features.note: FR-211 requires an explicit null on conventional weekends. These counts are the nulls, stated rather than assumed.

corpus_provenance.why_not_the_window: sprint weekends began in 2021, so no earlier season has a sprint result to collect (FR-211)
corpus_provenance.stamped_retroactively: stamped after the fact, on 2026-09-05, from the seasons this file already names. It was written before results files carried provenance; re-running it would refetch an unchanged corpus over the network.
